text:
elaine: Pushing a new frame for trace detail header — need quick design + accessibility check. Main questions: where to surface the permalink/corr-id and how the export button should behave on mobile + huge traces. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/trace-header-v2 (frame: Permalink + Export)

sam: Nice work. My gut: put permalink/corr-id in a compact row beneath the title so title stays visually centered. On narrow screens we can stack it under and hide secondary metadata behind chevron.

miguel: From infra POV, permalink click should open request explorer, copy icon should copy permalink. Avoid click-to-copy on the whole breadcrumb (confuses users). We'll provide a dedicated /api/export endpoint for downloads.

devin: Mobile note: icon-only affordances are hard to hit. If we keep copy as icon-only, increase hit target to 44px and add text label on very small screens.

kate: Accessibility checklist: all actionable icons need aria-labels, focus outline, and 4.5:1 contrast for icon against background if considered primary. For secondary icons 3:1 is acceptable. Tooltips must be visible on keyboard focus and use aria-describedby.

elaine: Copy proposals: visible text shows shortened hash (e.g., 0a3f...9c2), tooltip/aria exposes full id. Visual label for breadcrumb could be `Corr` + short hash; aria-label on copy button: `Copy correlation ID <full-hash>`.

sam: Export CTA microcopy: `Download trace` vs `Export` — prefer `Download trace` since it communicates the immediate result. For the dropdown, primary action triggers JSON download; dropdown has CSV, flattened CSV, and HAR.

miguel: Edge case: traces > 50MB or >10k spans will be prepared async. UX: show a modal explaining "Preparing download — we'll email you when ready" with an inline progress spinner and estimated time. Backend returns a job id and status endpoint.

devin: For in-app UX of async export, let's add a small toast with a link to "view export status" which opens a lightweight modal showing job progress so users don't get disoriented.

kate: Keyboard navigation: Dropdown must be arrow-key navigable and close on Esc. When export starts, focus should move to a status region with role=status so screen readers announce progress updates.

sam: Visual: add a tiny link icon next to the breadcrumb (sep by 6px), clicking permalink opens explorer in same tab, copy icon next to it. On hover show full id in tooltip. On mobile show a single row: [Corr 0a3f...9c2] [Download trace]

elaine: Designer ask: I'll update Figma to show breadcrumb under title, 44px tappable copy, primary Download + chevron. Also will add an export status modal frame. Tagging for final pass in 1hr.

ui-bot: Accessibility scan: flagged 2 contrast issues in current frame (icon color on dark header, dropdown chevron hit area). Report: /reports/1978643210

miguel: I'll prototype the async-export flow + status modal and wire the job API. Will add feature flag for the async path.

devin: I'll write the copy strings for the modal + toast. Draft: "Preparing your trace export. We'll email you when it's ready. You can also view progress here." and fallback copy for very large traces: "Export may take several minutes."

kate: small a11y nit: the toast link should have discernible text (avoid "here" alone). Use "view export progress".

sam: I'll do a quick copy pass after devin. Also confirm analytics events: export_initiated, export_ready, export_failed, export_download_clicked.

elaine: Great. Thanks all — updating Figma now and will @channel when frames are ready for dev handoff.
